## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` and `npm run typecheck` pass in `desktop/`
- [ ] New Vietnamese UI text has an English entry (`desktop/src/shared/i18n/catalog/`)
- [ ] Rules live in `desktop/src/shared` with a unit test; Muse selectors stay in the one adapter module
- [ ] Generated files were regenerated by their script, not edited (e.g. `bun scripts/changelog.ts`)
- [ ] No keys, tokens, cookies, real accounts or personal data in code, tests, logs or screenshots
